messages:
Tara: thanks everyone for a smooth webinar. action items: gated replay page, 3 social clips, embargoed benchmark PDF (legal hold), HubSpot routing for leads. need owners + timelines.
Jon: I can do the replay landing page and gating. ETA 10:30 PT. Reminder: include EU consent checkbox for registrants.
Priya: I will handle the social clips (30s, 60s, 90s) and thumbnails. will need timecodes from the export.
Amir: I9ll pull the Zoom raw and generate SRTs (en-US). deploy-bot shows upload path.
deploy-bot: recording uploaded -> gs://redwood-webinars/2026-03-20/session-recording.mp4 (1.7GB)
Tara: HubSpot routing: please capture utm params, webinar_id, watch_pct, demo_click. Lead scoring rule: watch_pct >=50 -> add tag "webinar_mql"; demo_click -> add "webinar_demo_interest" and notify #sales.
Jon: noted. I9ll add those fields to the form and pass them via the webhook to our routing lambda.
Priya: clip plan: 30s teaser (open), 60s demo highlight, 90s benchmark summary. Amir pls provide srt + rough timecodes by 9:45 PT.
Amir: will do SRT + an edit manifest. ffmpeg sample I9m using: `ffmpeg -ss 00:12:15 -i session-recording.mp4 -t 00:01:30 -c copy clip-demo-90.mp4` will upload to clips/ with manifest.json.
Tara: legal: do not publish benchmark PDF or link until @Amir-Legal signs off. also confirm speaker approvals for use of quotes.
Amir: I9ll ping Legal and provide the PDF for review. expect sign-off by 08:30 PT.
Tara: timeline recap: clips + srt by 09:45 PT, landing + gating by 10:30 PT, HubSpot + email draft by 11:00 PT, legal sign-off by 08:30 PT. react with :white_check_mark: when you accept.
Jon: :white_check_mark: on landing + form.
Priya: :white_check_mark: on clips.
Amir: :white_check_mark: on recordings/SRTs and legal ping.
Tara: I9ll update the Asana task and schedule the replay send after legal clears. will post back here when live.
